info.name: Kiteworks API Documentation activities locations API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of locations to return. Must be between 1 and 10000.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of locations to skip before returning results, for pagination.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Sort order for the results. Default is `name:asc`.
Allowed values: `name`, `name:asc`, `name:desc`.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns a paginated list of available locations.
### Precondition:
  User must be authenticated.
### Response:
  Returns the list of locations.

params.name: returnEntity
params.description: If set to `true`, returns information about the newly created entity.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs: Creates a new location entry with a name and optional domain. Requires system admin privileges.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the location to be retrieved

items.docs: Returns the details of the specified location, including its name and DNS URL.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the location to remove from

items.docs: Permanently deletes the specified location. Requires system admin privileges.
